persos.desc: boy around 9, sky-blue-and-silver t-shirt, gap-toothed smile
persos.pose: sitting in the dentist chair on the left, relaxed

dialogue: Mon petit, qui te donne tous ces bonbons-là ?! Tes dents sont gâtées dêh !
C'est ta femme, docteur. Elle vend ça devant ton cabinet-là.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The dentist shakes the dental mirror and scolds, face turned to the camera. The boy shrugs and answers very naturally, his face clearly visible.
chute: The dentist freezes, the mirror still in the air. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the angry dentist's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE DENTISTE CE SOIR À LA MAISON :
mecanisme: témoin innocent (enfant) qui révèle le business du couple
